### parse

[Source](contracts.aug#L4)

Parse strict UTF-8 JSON. Duplicate keys, invalid Unicode, oversized integers, and nesting beyond 64 levels raise JsonError.

It takes `input` as a string.

Failures can raise `JsonError`.
